scope: api/routes literal registrations; read with generated inventory and parent middleware. This is an implementation audit, not proof of absence of vulnerabilities.

reviewedFiles.api/routes/admin-users.route.ts: /api/admin: requireAdmin (hono-routes.ts). User IDs resolve through AuthService; enable/disable have no body.
reviewedFiles.api/routes/agentic-search.route.ts: Authenticated user passed to service; shared knowledge search is not project-owned. AgenticSearchRequestSchema validates body.
reviewedFiles.api/routes/artifacts.route.ts: ArtifactParamSchema and query/body schemas; conversation userId scoped SQL before read/update.
reviewedFiles.api/routes/assessment-campaigns.route.ts: Authenticated read-only fixed catalog; no body, query or owned record input.
reviewedFiles.api/routes/assessments.route.ts: assertOwner plus userId-scoped AssessmentRepository. Shared request/status schemas; malformed JSON -> 400.
reviewedFiles.api/routes/auth.route.ts: Login/refresh/logout public by explicit middleware allowlist; me requires auth. Credentials schema and AuthService/session verification; cookie and CSRF rules in parent.
reviewedFiles.api/routes/business-logic.route.ts: assertOwner; scenario/generate schemas; scenario execution additionally resolves owned engagement and target.
reviewedFiles.api/routes/chat.route.ts: ConversationParamSchema/query/body schemas; SQL and chat service scope to authenticated userId.
reviewedFiles.api/routes/dast-auth.route.ts: assertOwner before read/mutation; assertTarget binds project; rotate/get scoped by projectId. Shared schemas and malformed JSON -> 400; no plaintext secret response.
reviewedFiles.api/routes/dast.route.ts: assertProjectOwner and target/profile/run project membership; shared schemas/readJson. Source execution additionally authorizes configured project path.
reviewedFiles.api/routes/diagnostics.route.ts: assertScanOwner follows scan -> project; body schemas/readJsonBody; repository-reading inventory authorizes configured project path.
reviewedFiles.api/routes/dynamic.route.ts: Project owner and nested run/artifact project binding; request safeParse; source access authorizes configured path before invocation.
reviewedFiles.api/routes/finding-decisions.route.ts: Decision -> finding -> scan -> project owner before GET; no body required.
reviewedFiles.api/routes/finding-reviews.route.ts: Review -> finding -> scan -> project owner before GET; no body required.
reviewedFiles.api/routes/findings.route.ts: Finding -> scan -> project owner before reads/mutations; decision schema; finding-review start has no request body.
reviewedFiles.api/routes/health.route.ts: /api/health public status only; /ready remains authenticated by parent allowlist. No caller-controlled body or query.
Shared route context; project owner then resolveWebProjectPath. zValidator JSON object and bounded enums/limits before preflight.
reviewedFiles.api/routes/project-scan.route.ts: Project owner then resolveWebProjectPath; zValidator request; configured execution policy before process launch.
reviewedFiles.api/routes/projects.route.ts: Owner-scoped list/find; createProjectSchema and canonical allowed roots; folder picker checked after selection. Mounted scan routes inherit same context.
reviewedFiles.api/routes/reproductions.route.ts: Project owner; finding/run/artifact project membership; shared request schema and configured source path check.
reviewedFiles.api/routes/scan-launches.route.ts: scanLaunchPreviewRequestSchema; project owner and configured path before capability analysis.
reviewedFiles.api/routes/scan-profiles.route.ts: Authenticated read-only profile catalog; selected profile IDs resolve catalog entries, no project record.
reviewedFiles.api/routes/scan-reports.route.ts: checkReportOwnership follows report -> scan -> project; artifact validation and storage boundaries before download.
reviewedFiles.api/routes/scans.route.ts: checkScanOwnership follows scan -> project; list project owner; query helpers and shared mutation schemas. Empty review body remains optional, malformed JSON -> 400. Deletion service separately scopes owner.
reviewedFiles.api/routes/search.route.ts: SearchRequestSchema; authenticated shared-source retrieval, no project ownership semantics.
reviewedFiles.api/routes/settings.route.ts: System context is userId scoped; runtime/LLM read and write requireAdmin locally. Shared update schemas; secret redaction in settings handlers.
reviewedFiles.api/routes/sources.route.ts: Authenticated shared wiki reads; requireAdminForMutation. Query/write schemas; source-path normalizer and filesystem boundary for wildcard paths.
reviewedFiles.api/routes/static-intelligence.route.ts: assertProjectOwner/assertScanOwner; registered handlers and shared request parsing in static-intelligence route helpers/services. Repository access additionally uses common path resolver.
reviewedFiles.api/routes/threat-models.route.ts: ownedProject and repository owned-run lookups; request readers validate before persisted model operations; buildCurrentModel authorizes source path.
